_note: Pinned Commons originals for the distilled image layer. Each source is a public-domain or CC0 work, named by its exact Commons title. The transform is deterministic: 16:9 crop around `focus`, 1600x900, grayscale, autocontrast, median filter, gamma, six-tone posterization, then three edge-clamped glitch bands. Never `exact`: the source record establishes identity and date, not the frame.

sources.title: File:Clara Bow 1927.jpg
sources.caption: A distilled profile portrait of Clara Bow, from a 1927 studio photograph.
sources.look_reason: Looked at the generated 1600x900 file: Bow's profile fills the right half, with the ear, eye, nose and lips clear; the dark hair and pale wall hold the silhouette. The 1927 date and the identification as Bow come from the Commons record, not from the frame.

sources.title: File:Gibson Girl by Charles Dana Gibson.jpg
sources.caption: A distilled close-up of the Gibson Girl, from Charles Dana Gibson's drawing.
sources.look_reason: Looked at the generated 1600x900 file: both eyes, brows, nose and mouth are clear, and the pen strokes of the hair read across the top; the crown is cropped a little but the face is intact. The Gibson attribution and date come from the source record.

sources.title: File:Mickey Mouse - Steamboat Willie (1928).jpg
sources.caption: A distilled frame from Steamboat Willie, with Mickey Mouse at a ship's wheel.
sources.look_reason: Looked at the generated 1600x900 file: Mickey's head, ears, muzzle, body and tail are clear against the deck; a ship's wheel sits at the left. The 1928 film and the character's identification come from the Commons record, not from the frame.
